content: Schema migration races on first concurrent open: two processes both read PRAGMA user_version=0 outside a transaction and both apply a non-idempotent migration, so the loser fails with duplicate column or UNIQUE constraint failed; also CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS and trigger recreation are not atomic across connections. Fix: wrap the whole migration (bootstrap, applied-version read, DDL, version bump) in one BEGIN IMMEDIATE transaction and re-read user_version inside the lock; busy_timeout serializes contenders at BEGIN, whereas deferred transactions can fail with SQLITE_BUSY_SNAPSHOT which busy_timeout never retries; treat concurrent already-exists as success; add a bounded retry around open because the WAL mode switch itself needs a brief exclusive lock and does not always invoke the busy handler.
